title: Agent not reporting after install on Ubuntu 22.04
problem: Customer installed nimbus-agent but the host never appeared. Agent log showed NM-1001.
resolution: The host was behind a corporate HTTP proxy. The customer had set HTTPS_PROXY but the agent ignores it. Setting proxy_url in /etc/nimbus/agent.yaml and restarting nimbus-agent fixed it.

title: Data points rejected for Windows hosts
problem: Metrics from several Windows VMs had gaps; agent logged NM-4021.
resolution: Windows Time service was disabled on the VM template, causing clock skew over 60 seconds. Enabling the Windows Time service and restarting NimbusAgent resolved it.

title: Alerts firing during planned database upgrade
problem: Customer got paged repeatedly during a scheduled Postgres upgrade.
resolution: Advised creating a maintenance window scoped to service:postgres for the upgrade period. Monitors keep evaluating but notifications are suppressed. Customer also set up a recurring window via cron for weekly maintenance.

title: HTTP 429 from API during dashboard export script
problem: Customer automation hit 429 errors exporting dashboards.
resolution: Script exceeded 600 requests/minute. Added handling of the Retry-After header and pagination with next_cursor instead of re-requesting. Support also granted a temporary 2x rate limit override for 72 hours while they fixed the script.

title: Webhook payloads rejected by customer endpoint
problem: Customer's endpoint rejected webhooks as unauthenticated.
resolution: Customer was computing the HMAC over the parsed and re-serialized JSON. The X-Nimbus-Signature is computed over the raw request body; verifying against the raw bytes fixed it.

title: EU workspace agents cannot connect
problem: New EU workspace, all agents log NM-1001.
resolution: Agents were configured with the US endpoint ingest.nimbus-monitor.example. EU workspaces must use ingest.eu1.nimbus-monitor.example. Updated the endpoint in agent.yaml.

title: Lost historical data after plan change
problem: Customer downgraded from Team to Free and lost 3 weeks of metrics.
resolution: Expected behavior: on downgrade, data older than the new plan's retention (7 days for Free) is deleted and cannot be recovered. Explained the policy and offered a trial upgrade; data could not be restored.

title: Slack notifications not arriving in private channel
problem: Monitor messages mention @slack-sre-private but nothing arrives.
resolution: The Nimbus Slack app had not been invited to the private channel. After /invite @Nimbus in the channel, notifications arrived.

title: Kubernetes DaemonSet pods CrashLoopBackOff
problem: After helm install the nimbus-agent pods crash.
resolution: Cluster was running Kubernetes 1.24; the chart requires 1.26 or newer. Customer upgraded the cluster; pods started normally.

title: Too many alert notifications during outage
problem: An AZ outage triggered 300 per-host notifications.
resolution: Enabled Group notifications on the multi-alert monitor so a single notification is sent when many hosts trigger within 5 minutes.

title: Agent upgrade from 2.8 fails
problem: apt upgrade of nimbus-agent from 2.8 to 3.4 fails with a dependency error.
resolution: Agents older than 3.0 cannot be upgraded in place. Uninstalled 2.8 and reinstalled 3.4 using the install script with the same ingestion key.

title: NM-4029 errors from custom metrics
problem: Agent logs payload too large after adding custom metrics.
resolution: Custom metric had a request_id tag creating millions of series. Removed the high-cardinality tag and reduced batch_size; errors stopped.

title: Ingestion backlog for workspace after incident
problem: Customer's dashboards showed data 40 minutes behind after NM-5003 events.
resolution: Checked the Ingestion tab in the admin console; backlog was growing for over 15 minutes. Ran the redrive-partition job for the workspace and the backlog cleared in about 10 minutes.

title: Monitor flapping between OK and ALERT
problem: CPU monitor at 85% threshold flips state every few minutes.
resolution: Added a recovery threshold of 75% and kept a 5 minute evaluation window. Flapping stopped.

title: Customer reports API key posted on public GitHub
problem: Customer accidentally committed a read-write API key to a public repo.
resolution: Followed the restricted security process: force-revoked the key from the admin console, pulled 30 days of audit logs for the security ticket, and paged sec-oncall. No malicious use found.

title: New hosts never appear, agent log shows NM-1004
problem: A bank rolled the agent out to 40 hosts in a locked-down network segment. None appeared. The log repeats NM-1004.
resolution: Their outbound proxy re-signs TLS. Exported the proxy root certificate to /etc/nimbus/corp-ca.pem and set ca_bundle_path. Hosts appeared within two minutes.

title: Hosts offline after firewall change
problem: All hosts in one data center went offline on Tuesday morning. Agents log NM-1001. Nothing changed on the hosts.
resolution: The network team had replaced the egress rule with a fixed list of destination addresses that was out of date. Pointed them at the published ranges.json file; after the firewall rule was updated the hosts came back.

title: Host keeps flipping between two sets of metrics
problem: One host shows CPU jumping between 5% and 90% every few seconds and its tags keep changing. Log shows NM-2201.
resolution: Two VMs cloned from the same image shared a hostname. Set hostname_override on the clone and restarted the agent; a second host appeared and the graphs became stable.

title: Agent running, log clean, host still missing
problem: Customer insists the agent is healthy: nimbusctl status is green and flushes succeed, yet the host is not in their workspace.
resolution: Looked up the ingestion key in the admin console: it belonged to the customer's sandbox workspace, not production. They deployed the production key with nimbusctl key rotate and the host appeared.

title: Hosts disappear for a few minutes several times a day
problem: Hosts in a busy container cluster drop out for 2 to 3 minutes and come back. Log shows NM-2010 before each gap.
resolution: Agents were 3.3.1 with container_discovery enabled: the known memory leak. Raised memory_limit_mb to 512 as a stopgap and scheduled the upgrade to 3.4; no further restarts after the upgrade.

title: NM-1010 on hosts in a new VPC
problem: Agents in a newly created VPC log NM-1010 and never connect.
resolution: The VPC had no DNS resolver for external names. After the customer enabled DNS resolution on the VPC the agents connected without further changes.

title: Agent refuses to start after config management run
problem: After an Ansible run the agent no longer starts. Log shows NM-1110.
resolution: The playbook wrote agent.yaml with mode 0644. Changed the template to owner nimbus and mode 0640; the agent started.

title: Missing data after laptops wake from sleep
problem: Developer laptops running the agent show holes in graphs each morning; log shows NM-4012.
resolution: On resume the agent replayed buffered points that were more than 4 hours old, which ingestion rejects. Expected. Advised lowering buffer_max_age_s so stale data is discarded locally, and that the backfill API exists if they need the old points.

title: Six-hour hole in metrics after network outage
problem: A site lost connectivity for six hours. After it returned only the last half hour of data was filled in.
resolution: By design: buffered data older than buffer_max_age_s (30 minutes by default) is discarded. Customer raised buffer_max_age_s to 14400 and buffer_max_mb to 2000 for that site.

title: Random gaps across a 3,000-host fleet
problem: Large customer sees short gaps on random hosts at peak time. Agent logs NM-4201.
resolution: All 3,000 hosts shared one ingestion key and exceeded 10,000 points per second on it. Split the fleet across four keys; the errors stopped.

title: Metrics from one application are all dropped
problem: A new service emits StatsD metrics but none arrive. Log shows NM-4022.
resolution: Metric names contained uppercase letters and hyphens (Checkout-Latency). Renamed them to lowercase with underscores; data arrived.

title: Points rejected with NM-4020 on new servers
problem: Freshly racked servers have all data rejected; log shows NM-4020.
resolution: The hardware clock was set to local time but the OS treated it as UTC, putting the clock 9 hours ahead. Fixed the hardware clock setting and enabled chrony.

title: EU agents rejected with HTTP 421
problem: After a migration, agents log NM-5001 and no data arrives.
resolution: The customer had moved to a new eu1 workspace but agents still pointed at the US endpoint with the new key. Set endpoint to ingest.eu1.nimbus-monitor.example.

title: PagerDuty incidents not created
problem: Monitor alerts but nothing shows in PagerDuty.
resolution: The integration key belonged to a PagerDuty service that had been deleted. Customer added the key of the current service under Settings > Integrations > PagerDuty.

title: Nobody was paged for a production outage
problem: A database outage alerted in Nimbus at 02:10 but no one was notified. Event history shows NM-7021.
resolution: The escalation policy's first level pointed at a schedule with a gap between two rotations. Added a fallback team to every level.

title: Webhook notifications stopped a week ago
problem: Customer's incident bot stopped receiving webhooks. Event history shows NM-7002.
resolution: Their receiver had returned errors during a deploy and the channel was disabled after 50 consecutive failures. Re-enabled the channel on the integrations page.

title: Slack alerts stopped for the whole company
problem: No Slack notifications in any channel since Monday. Email still works.
resolution: The customer had renamed their Slack workspace on Monday. Known issue: the app token is invalidated. Reinstalling the Nimbus Slack app restored notifications.

title: Alerts silent since last maintenance
problem: Monitors for the payments service show ALERT in the UI but nobody has been notified for three days.
resolution: A maintenance window scoped to service:payments had been created with an end date a week out by mistake. Deleted the window.

title: Alert emails not received by one team
problem: One team says they get no alert emails; others do.
resolution: Their mail gateway was quarantining mail from alerts@nimbus-monitor.example. After they allow-listed the address the emails arrived.

title: Paged during maintenance by a disk forecast
problem: Customer set a maintenance window for a storage migration and was still paged by a disk-space forecast monitor.
resolution: Known issue: forecast monitors ignore maintenance windows. Advised muting that monitor by hand during the work.

title: Control-plane nodes missing from host list
problem: A 3-master, 20-worker cluster shows only 20 hosts.
resolution: The DaemonSet had no tolerations for the control-plane taint. Added tolerations in the Helm values; the three nodes appeared.

title: Agent pods OOMKilled on large nodes
problem: Agent pods restart with reason OOMKilled on nodes that run about 200 pods each.
resolution: The default 512Mi memory limit is too low for that pod density. Raised resources.limits.memory to 1Gi.

title: No deployment or replica metrics
problem: Dashboards for kube_deployment metrics are empty although node and pod metrics work.
resolution: The cluster agent was not enabled. Set clusterAgent.enabled to true in the chart values.

title: Key visible in Helm values in git
problem: Security review flagged the ingestion key committed in a values file.
resolution: Moved the key to a Kubernetes Secret and referenced it with existingSecret. Rotated the exposed ingestion key.

title: Java stack traces split into dozens of entries
problem: Each line of a stack trace shows as a separate log entry, which makes searching useless.
resolution: Set logs.multiline_pattern to match the timestamp at the start of each entry. Traces now arrive as one entry.

title: No logs arriving although paths are configured
problem: Customer listed files under logs.paths but nothing shows in the log explorer. No errors in the agent log.
resolution: Log collection is off by default: logs.enabled was missing. After setting it to true logs arrived.

title: Logs stop every afternoon
problem: Logs vanish around 15:00 UTC every day and come back at midnight. Agent logs NM-4120.
resolution: The workspace reached its daily indexed-log quota. Customer added an exclusion filter for debug lines and raised the quota.

title: NM-2120 for application log
problem: Agent logs NM-2120 for /srv/app/logs/app.log.
resolution: The parent directory /srv/app was mode 0700. Granted execute permission on the directory to the nimbus user.

title: Card numbers visible in indexed logs
problem: Customer found payment card numbers in their logs in Nimbus.
resolution: Added a redact_patterns entry for card numbers on the agents so the values never leave the hosts, and a scrubbing processor in the pipeline as a second layer. Existing indexed logs age out with retention.

title: 401 from REST API with a valid key
problem: Customer's script gets 401 on every call and they are sure the key is right.
resolution: They were using an ingestion key. Ingestion keys are not accepted by the REST API. Created a read-only API key.

title: Old integration breaks on API v2
problem: A script written in 2023 fails after its base URL was changed to /v2.
resolution: The script sent X-Api-Key and used page and per_page. v2 needs Authorization: Bearer and cursor pagination. The customer's v1 key kept working once the header was changed.

title: Export script returns only 100 monitors
problem: Customer has 340 monitors but the list endpoint returns 100.
resolution: The script ignored next_cursor. After following the cursor until it was empty, all 340 were returned.

title: Dashboard queries fail with NM-6010
problem: A 90-day query grouped by host, container and endpoint times out.
resolution: Reduced the range to 7 days and grouped by service only. For long ranges advised a top-10 function.

title: 403 when creating monitors from CI
problem: CI pipeline gets 403 creating monitors. Log shows NM-6003.
resolution: The pipeline used a read-only key. Issued a read-write key from a service account.

title: Shared dashboard link stopped working
problem: A link the customer had embedded in their status wiki returns Not Found.
resolution: Public links expire after 30 days and cannot be extended. Regenerated the link; advised a calendar reminder or an API-key-based embed.

title: CSV export missing rows in EU workspace
problem: An export that should have 400,000 rows stops at 100,000.
resolution: Known issue in eu1. Advised exporting four shorter ranges or pulling the data through the REST API.

title: SAML sign-in loops back to the login page
problem: After enabling SAML every user is bounced back to the login page.
resolution: The identity provider sent an opaque ID as NameID. Changed NameID to the email address; sign-in worked.

title: SAML assertions rejected intermittently
problem: Some sign-ins fail with an invalid assertion message, mostly in the morning.
resolution: The self-hosted identity provider's clock drifted by about 5 minutes. After time sync was fixed on that server the errors stopped.

title: Role change through group not applied
problem: Customer moved a user to the admins group in their directory 20 minutes ago and the user is still a Viewer.
resolution: Known delay for SCIM group changes of up to 40 minutes. The role updated by itself after about half an hour.

title: Automation broke when an engineer left
problem: Terraform runs fail with 401 since a team member was removed.
resolution: The key was unaffected; the pipeline was using the engineer's personal session token. Moved the pipeline to an API key issued from a service account.

title: Invoice doubled after autoscaling test
problem: Customer ran a load test with 400 extra hosts for two days and the invoice shows 90 more hosts than usual.
resolution: Billing uses the 99th percentile of hourly host count; two full days is more than 1% of the month, so the test counted. Exported the hourly host report to show the calculation. Granted a goodwill credit within the support limit.

title: Charged after cancelling
problem: Customer cancelled on the 10th and received an invoice on the 1st of the next month.
resolution: Expected: usage in the final billing period is invoiced on the following 1st. No further invoices will be issued.

title: Workspace suspended while payment is in transit
problem: Enterprise customer paid by bank transfer; the transfer had not cleared and the workspace was about to be suspended.
resolution: Set the billing_hold flag to delay suspension by 7 days. The payment cleared on day 3.

title: Custom metric overage after a release
problem: Custom metric count went from 4,000 to 190,000 overnight.
resolution: A release added a customer_email tag to a request counter. Customer removed the tag; the series count fell back over the next day. Billing lead approved waiving the overage.

title: Uptime check alerts although the site is up
problem: Customer is paged a few times a week for a site that is fine from everywhere they test.
resolution: All failures came from the Sydney location, which has a known upstream problem. Changed the check to alert only when 2 locations fail.

title: Cannot test an intranet endpoint
problem: HTTP check for an internal hostname always fails with a DNS error.
resolution: Managed locations cannot reach private addresses. The customer is on Enterprise, so they deployed a private location container inside their network.

title: Leaked key was used from an unknown network
problem: A read-write key was exposed in a public CI log for 6 hours. The seclake query showed 2,100 dashboard reads from an ASN the customer had never used and one new webhook.
resolution: Revoked the key and the webhook it created, opened a P1 security incident, and the security lead notified the customer's Admins in writing within 72 hours using SEC-NOTIFY-02.

title: Court order requesting customer data
problem: A law firm emailed support with a court order asking whether a named company is a customer and for its monitoring data.
resolution: Did not confirm or deny. Forwarded the request unanswered to the legal team and logged it in the SEC queue. Legal instructed a legal hold on the workspace, set by a security lead.

title: Admin asks for a full export of their workspace data
problem: A workspace Admin requested a copy of all raw data ahead of a migration to another vendor.
resolution: Verified the requester with a callback to the phone number on the contract, then opened a SEC ticket. The security team delivered the export on day 12.
